newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-First Boston on NL Industries.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-First Boston on NL Industries.

text.p: -- CS First Boston analyst David Silver cited favorable market and industry developments in titanium dioxide for his upgrade of NL Industries Inc to buy from hold.
-- Silver said "there are now strong signs" that the markets for titanium, the company's major product, also known as white pigment, "have bottomed."
-- said demand is strengthening, producer inventories have fallen, and a price increase "is on the table" for North America at five percent, and Europe at five to eight percent, effective April 1.
-- reduced 1997 earnings estimate to loss $0.40 per share from loss $0.25.

-- believes first quarter 1997 "will be the cyclical earnings trough...and we see substantial upside potential due to very high operating and financial leverage that could be unlocked if a lengthy cyclical upturn in (product) margins is matched with receptive capital markets."
